purpose: Lightroom colour mixer response tables of the production model (ColorMixerModel.h)

method.statistic: pixel mean per cell over the scenes (rotation clipped to +-90 deg, log gains to +-3/+-1)
method.excluded: encoded channel <= 0.002 or >= 0.995 in either export; Oklab C <= near grey; L <= 0.08
method.monotone: isotonic per cell of the main quantity on each side of zero
method.magenta_shift_reason: user choice 2026-10-22: keep magenta near the former IPR band, shifted slightly
method.cross_validation: two folds of alternate scenes; error = |predicted - LR| pixel mean over the band window, main quantity
